coverLetter.paragraph: Having built and executed end-to-end digital marketing strategies across SEO, paid acquisition, content, and analytics at Orange, Algorithmics, and Nuelink, I bring a full-stack growth perspective to every role I take on. At Orange, I led the digital strategy for Orange Travel (international eSIM) and developed an AI-powered automation tool for netlinking opportunity identification — a testament to my ability to combine strategic thinking with technical execution. Bilingual in French and English, data-driven, and motivated by measurable impact, I am ready to contribute from my very first week.
